about: GPU seconds per second of rendered video, measured on our first film (Girl In The Magic Tub, 2026-11-13 to 2026-11-15) on RTX 3090s at 1280x704. Copied from the maintainers' own baseline (flix/baseline.json, gpu.gpu_seconds_per_video_second, timed rows of stats/jobs.jsonl). Replace with this machine's own log when it has one.

by_card.note: the first film's GPU 0 ran near full memory and was three times slower; a card over twice its own median should stop getting renders
